title: jpipe-runner report 1.0
description: What a run of jpipe-runner concluded (ADR-0011): every element of the justification, with its status, its step and what that step declares, observed and produced; then every diagnostic. Within a major version, a minor version only adds optional fields: a consumer ignores fields it does not know. This schema is strict, so that the runner cannot emit a field it does not document. Documented in docs/report-schema.md.

justification.description: The justification's name, or null if the model was refused before it could be read.

verdict.description: fail if an element failed; skip if none failed and one was skipped; pass if every element passed; invalid if nothing ran, because the model was refused, a step library could not be imported, or validation reported an error.

strict.description: Whether validation counted warnings as errors.

elements.description: Every element of the justification, in the order the runner takes them: each after the elements that support it. Empty if the model was refused.

diagnostics.description: Every problem found, in the order found: loading the model, importing the libraries or validating them, then running each element.

diagram.description: The path of the diagram drawn for this run, as it was given to the runner, or null.

summary.description: How many elements ended in each status, and how many diagnostics of each severity. pass + fail + skip + not_run = elements.

aliases.description: The ids of the elements that composition merged into this one.

supports.description: The ids of the elements it supports.

reason.description: Why it did not pass: the reason its step gave, the problem found, or the elements that stopped it.

blocked_by.description: The elements upstream that stopped it, failed or skipped on their own account. Empty unless it was skipped because of them.

bound_to.description: The step bound to it, as module.function, or null if it is unbound.

bound_by.description: The ids, as the step names them, that designate this element.

observes.description: The paths and globs its step declares it observes, relative to where the runner runs.

consumes.description: The variables its step declares it consumes.

produces.description: The variables its step declares it produces.

produced.description: The values its step produced, by variable.

artifacts.description: The files its step observed, recorded just before it was called.

value.description: A produced value: the value itself if it is JSON, otherwise its Python repr and type.

artifact.description: A file an evidence observed. A glob that matched nothing is recorded once, under its pattern, as unreachable.

path.description: Relative to where the runner runs, with / as separator.

code.description: The contract: a code never changes meaning. docs/rules.md lists them.

element.description: The id of the element it is about, if it is about one.

message.description: Written for people: it may be reworded in any release.

traceback.description: The exception behind it, for a step that raised (JP022) or a library that failed to import (JP020).

exception.description: The exception's type, qualified by its module unless it is a built-in.

frames.description: The frames of the step's or library's own code, from the outermost call to where it was raised.

cause.description: The exception it was raised from, or while handling.

file.description: Relative to where the runner runs, with / as separator, when the file is under it.
